plan_notes: RECENCY: lead with outlet RSS / sitemap_news.xml feeds (rss_feeds_first) and filter by pubDate within the 72h window (since 2026-10-18T22:00Z). WebSearch site: queries tend to return evergreen pages - use WebSearch only to fill gaps, and verify every published time on the article page itself. 10-22 is a Thursday (KST): Wednesday 10-21 US/EU releases are the freshest primary documents; Korean ministry releases from Wednesday/Thursday KST also qualify.
OUTPUT: write candidates under the key "items" (NOT "candidates").

SCOPE: follow sources.json categories[politics]._note - three axes only: (1) policy/regulation, (2) AI in elections & public opinion, (3) AI geopolitics. No AI-less general politics; if deleting AI from the headline leaves a standing story, drop it. Aim for spread across all three axes and regions.

BALANCE: 10-21 was US-federal/US-local heavy (DHS DeepSeek, Democrats letter, NYC chatbot rule) plus UK FCA and Korea-UN; it had zero geopolitics-export-control and zero court-ruling cards. Today prioritize court rulings/filings (copyright, liability), formal geopolitics actions (BIS/Dutch/Japanese export rules, smuggling cases, Gulf/Asia compute deals, China CAC rules), elections outside the US (Brazil Oct 25 runoff TSE AI rulings, platform labelling, influence-op takedowns), EU AI Office / Digital Omnibus formal steps, data-center siting decisions, and Asia (Korea National Assembly / PIPC, Japan, India). Avoid a second US-federal-agency or UK-speech card unless it is a major new decision. Prefer decisions over essays/podcasts/analysis.

NEUTRALITY: non-partisan; report what was decided/filed/published; attribute contested claims to the named party; no horse-race or polling commentary (esp. Brazil runoff Oct 25, US midterms Nov 3). Prefer primary documents; primary doc and news report about it are ONE story.

DEDUP: do not resubmit anything in recently_published_do_not_resubmit. Follow-ups qualify only with a NEW ruling, filing, bill, executive order or official release (e.g. EO 14409 framework text, Newsom OES recommendations, NYC final chatbot rule, FCA consultation text, TSE ruling on Meta AI, formal EU AI Office decision, Korea AI Basic Act National Assembly passage, CMA final SMS decision, actual DUV export rule, Character.AI sale order). Commentary/analysis/reactions on published events are dropped.
CROSS-SECTION: stories about AI ad products (marketing), AI chip hardware launches (gadgets) or medical AI approvals (medicine) belong elsewhere unless a government/regulator action is the news.
Paywalled/crawler-blocked majors (reuters, bloomberg, ft, wsj, nytimes, economist, foreignpolicy) are excluded - find the same decision on an allowed outlet or the primary source.
